    Anna's Tales is one of two British English dubs of Le storie di Anna. It premiered on Channel 5 in the United Kingdom on May 2, 2005. It later aired on CITV both during and outside the Toonattik and CITV Preschool blocks in March 5, 2007, and then later aired on both Pop Girl and Tiny Pop from November 10, 2008 until the show stopped airing on Tiny Pop on August 23, 2013, but then stopped airing on Pop Girl on May 23, 2014.
    ​
    Anyone have this cartoon series please share it here, at this point I don't even care if it's SD or LD quality. The only collections I can find is in YouTube and it's in Indian language
    In in english dub please.
